text:
B: Hiya! Ooh, you're the Forest fan. I'm Joanne.
A: Liam. Alright? Yeah, scarf's always out, that. Where are you?
B: Warrington. And you're the electrician, aren't you? I've heard about you.
A: Have you? Who's been talking?
B: Kerry! You told her she was wrong about bread rolls. She was fuming, bless her.
A: Ha! Well, she was. It's a cob. End of.
B: It's a barm, love. But I'll let you off, you're East Midlands, you can't help it.
A: Nah, sorry, but barm's not even a word. Sounds like something you'd put on a cut.
B: Cheeky! My son's an electrician, actually. Well, apprentice. Kieran, he's twenty-three. Third year.
A: Is he? Good lad. Who's he with?
B: A firm in town, they do a lot of new builds. He says it's boring, just the same house fifty times. He's dead clever though, he wants to do the solar side, all that.
A: That's exactly where I'm going. Self-employed, couple of years, EV chargers and solar. My own van, name on the side. Then a lad or two working for me. Proper money in it, you know? I did a charger cash-in-hand last month, three hours, and made more than I do in two days at work.
B: See, that's what I tell him! There's no point working for someone else. You want to be the one getting the bonus, do you know what I mean? Here, if you ever need a lad, I'll give you his number.
A: In Warrington? Bit of a commute, mate.
B: Ha, fair enough. Worth a try. What do you do when you're not working, then?
A: Bouldering, gym, five-a-side. Nights out in Nottingham, house and techno. I do a lot of city breaks. Berlin, Budapest, Lisbon.
B: Ooh, I've never done Berlin. I did Dubai for my forty-fifth, that was amazing. The hotel had a pool on the roof. And I've just booked Lanzarote for October.
A: Dubai, nah. Not for me. All shopping centres and fake beaches. I'd be bored by day three.
B: Well, you can be bored with a cocktail, can't you? I just like a bit of luxury. I've worked for it.
A: Fair. What is it you do?
B: Team leader in a contact centre, retentions. People ring up to leave and I talk them round. Best figures on the floor for years, that's how I got made up to team leader.
A: So you're the one who wouldn't let me cancel my broadband.
B: Probably! Did you stay?
A: I did, yeah. Annoyingly.
B: There you go then. Works, doesn't it? It's the same as you selling people extras, I bet you do that.
A: All the time. Go in for a socket, come out with a new consumer unit and an EV charger quote. People love it.
B: See! We're the same, me and you. I knew it from your photo, I said he'd be a laugh.
A: Did you? I'll take that. Do you watch the rugby, then, being Warrington?
B: Season tickets! Wolves. We were robbed by the ref on Friday, honestly.
A: Rugby league, I can't get into it. Bunch of lads running into each other.
B: Oh, don't you start, I've had that from...
